blurb: Guests rent boats with a captain to relax, enjoy the water, or hang out with friends and family on Lake Geneva. Rentals include use of inflatable rafts and allow stops on the lake for swimming or bar hopping. The business also sells and rents various boating products and inflatables such as kayaks, paddleboards, and utility rafts.
